result:
I would end the illusion of separateness.

Not by forcing people to be alike, but by removing the structural barrier that makes survival dependent on the failure of another. If the pain you inflict on someone else registered as instantly and physically within yourself, the calculus of greed and violence collapses. You could no longer harm the system you are a part of without harming your own nervous system. Empathy would become a law of physics, not just a moral ideal. Once the cost of cruelty is identical to the price of self-sabotage, the choice ends.
